evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Ensure high data quality, consistency, and governance across SAP and enterprise data
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Quality, consistency, governance and "reliable" products are the only register on the page and there is no speed language, so rigour.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: SAP finance and supply-chain data is named but no audit, regulatory or compliance language appears, so the generic "reliable, business-ready products" stays at moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Integrate SAP data into broader cloud data platforms like Databricks and Microsoft Fabric
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: An existing SAP estate being connected to an established cloud platform, with tools named in responsibilities, reads as mid.
evidence.jd_authorship: Build and optimize cloud-native data pipelines from SAP S/4HANA and other data sources
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Several bullets name precise systems (Datasphere, S/4HANA, SAC) but the last is generic stakeholder boilerplate, so mixed; agency-posted for an unnamed client.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Develop analytical datasets for SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) and Power BI
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The work is models and datasets for reporting consumers across the data platform; the only business reference is "business stakeholders".
evidence.autonomy_level: Design and implement data models and data products in SAP Datasphere
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Design and implement appears only for a scoped technical task and the rest is build, integrate and develop, so execution.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No AI use or AI-consuming infrastructure is asked of the candidate.
evidence.testing_framing: Ensure high data quality, consistency, and governance across SAP and enterprise data
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality and governance are an assigned responsibility with an ownership verb, though no testing tool or practice is named.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Delivery and capability framing with no risk, compliance or incident register.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Build and optimize cloud-native data pipelines
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Design, build, integrate and optimise in roughly equal measure, with no from-scratch or inherited-debt language.
